name: Zenjidou Saishuu Shori Ningyou Kururu-chan
original_name: 全自動最終処理人形クルルちゃん
source:
Near future. Inventor created three automatic muppet dolls. The story starts as a boy and a girl find them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]

近未來，一位發明家製造了三個能自動運作的人偶。故事從一名少年與一名少女發現它們時開始。
